newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover soared to 6.903 billion yuan from 1.233 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said the huge turnover was possibly a result of state banks offsetting their postitions on the interbank market after Beijing banned them from trading on the state debt repurchase market.
Securities houses, which are losing huge amounts of money on the repo market because of the ban, resorted to the interbank market and became major borrowers, traders said.

Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, traded actively on the market on Wednesday. The Shanghai and Beijing centres were net lenders, while Shandong and Liaoning were net borrowers, traders said.
